verdict: GBP is your only active channel and it dropped sharply this week.
narrative: Paid advertising on Meta and Google has been inactive for the full 28-day window, leaving your Google Business Profile as the sole source of engagement — 196 total actions including 57 calls and 92 direction requests. That profile activity fell 76.81% in the last 7 days versus the prior 7, with the final three days of August showing near-zero engagement; this is a confirmed trend, not a seasonal blip. At the same time, search clicks dropped 28.57% and website sessions fell 37% week-over-week, signaling that organic visibility is eroding alongside GBP. Two setup items — phone-call attribution and contact record cleanup — are being completed now so that the 57 calls and 243 contacts in the system can be properly connected to patient outcomes. Once those are in place, the scoreboard will reflect what the channel is actually producing and next steps on paid reactivation can be made on clean data.
